Managed Java proxies

Create real Java subclasses and control their Python peers.

Construct and bind

Use java_class() when Java needs the generated Class, new_java_instance() for a raw object, and from_java(..., init_args=...) to recover or attach a peer. extends(...) is a decorator entry point.

Lifecycle

Use on_pre_init and jpreconstructor for constructor arguments. on_post_init runs once the peer and its Java object are available. jrelease() calls on_release() and disconnects the Python overrides from the Java instance.

Decorator helpers

Use explicit argument types for ambiguous overloads. The generated Java method exposes its declared exceptions through reflection. New Python and MVEL methods, fields, and field accessors can use the static modifier. Declare a static Python method without self.

Java object access

Use JA and JNA to enable and disable non-public lookup. JGS and JNGS control JavaBean-style properties. JIR keeps the receiver in a method chain, and JNIR restores the method result. JS enables safe chaining with java.JNone and JNS disables it.
